violations.why: irq_indigo can preempt the task between its two reads of v_iris, so the two reads can return different values.
irq_kestrel (via irq_orchid) can write v_beacon between the task's reads in fn_saffron and fn_fjord.
irq_kestrel can write v_beacon between the two reads in the same expression, so the area is computed from inconsistent values.
